message.content: {"question":"The radius of the Earth is about R_E = 6370 km. An object with mass 20 kg is taken to a height of 160 km above the Earth's surface. 1) What is the object's mass at this height? 2) How much does the object weigh at this height?","options":{"A":"1) The mass decreases; 2) The weight is 196.0 N","B":"1) The mass is the same; 2) The weight is 186.5 N","C":"1) The mass is the same; 2) The weight is 196.0 N","D":"1) The mass decreases; 2) The weight is 186.5 N"},"correct":"B"}
